purpose: independent TED author-component six-domain validation, correcting documented backbone/teacher/inference differences from the shared-backbone adapter; not a continuation or a paper-number search
model: author UNet2D default 5 blocks, base16, BatchNorm
optimizer: Adam reset per domain; 2e-4 initial,1e-4 continual,gamma .99/epoch
teacher: author weights-only freeze with train-mode BN
inference: source-style per-slice batch-statistic BN; restore validation-mutated buffers, no parameter updates
data: same existing six-domain HDF5 train/validation order; no test; integer-truncated labels frozen
input_adaptation: 256x256 instead of source192; explicit slice-level minmax and clip[.001,.99] instead of source case-level normalization because case boundaries unverified
selection: first metadata val sequence block earliest max foreground micro Dice; remaining blocks developmental evaluation
limitations: true domain and case identity unverified
backbone differs from original benchmark adapter; no direct equal-budget performance ranking
case-level preprocessing and original author splits not reproduced
original source broadcasting in AKT retained for fidelity
failure: either seed failure stops pair, finite checks, hard per-worker timeout and allocated storage guard; no blind restart
artifacts: private rolling model/teacher/optimizer checkpoints; publish only code/protocol and cross-domain cross-seed aggregates
usage: User supplies pinned TED source checkout via REFERENCE_ROOT, HDF5 root via DATA_ROOT, output directory via WORK_ROOT, and fixed ARM_SEED. Copy this file to WORK_ROOT/protocol.json. Independent time/storage guard required.
